title: skills evals: 15 cases forbid (must_not_contain) a string their own expected_output uses, so a careful answer that names the trap fails
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

## What is wrong

A `must_not_contain` assertion fails an answer that contains the string anywhere, including in a sentence that names it as the thing to avoid. In these cases, the case's own `expected_output` (the model answer) uses the forbidden string. So an answer written like the expected output fails its own assertion. Swept on `main` with a script that checks each `must_not_contain` entry for a substring of the same case's `expected_output`:

| File | Case | Forbidden string(s) also in expected_output |
|:-----|:-----|:--------------------------------------------|
| skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json | 3 | `http.server` |
| skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json | 7 | `?ids=`, `?filter=` |
| skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json | 1 | `connector-esign` |
| skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json | 1 | `type: 'password'` |
| skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json | 2 | `many_to_many` |
| skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json | 3 | `distinct: true` |
| skills/objectstack-query/evals/filters-pagination-search.json | 4 | `fuzzy` |
| skills/objectstack-ui/evals/analytics-inline-vs-dataset.json | 1 | `valueField` |
| skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json | 1 | `definePage`, `slots.tabs`, `kind: 'full'` |
| skills/objectstack-ui/evals/record-page.json | 3 | `slots.tabs` |
| skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json | 11 | `submitLabel`, `confirmLabel`, `confirmText` |
| skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json | 12 | `$or`, `anyOf` |
| skills/objectstack-upgrade/evals/protocol-major-upgrade.json | 2 | `??` |
| skills/objectui/evals/schema-expressions.json | 1 | `props.value`, `props.label` |
| skills/objectui/evals/schema-expressions.json | 2 | `props.label` |

Some of these may be deliberate (the expected output names the wrong form to warn against it). Even then, the assertion fails the same warning in a real answer.

## Expected

- For each case, narrow the forbidden string to the shape a wrong answer would write (for example `using: 'owner_id` instead of `owner_id == current_user.id`; #31266 did this for its own case 12), or drop it where no narrow form exists.
- Optionally, add a check (in the existing eval validation, if there is one) that refuses a `must_not_contain` entry found in the same case's `expected_output`, so the pattern can't return.

## Evidence

Contract review on PR #31266, the "other sites" note (cases 1 and 2 of objects-fields-relationships.json). The seat then swept every skill's evals.
